name: The Tower Entrance
builder.info: In Front of the Entrance to the Tower
desc.short: A bustling square at the foot of a massive stone tower.
desc.long:
Massive iron-bound doors, covered in locked chains, seal shut the doors to a giant stone tower that dominates the landscape of this cobblestone market square. While the tower seems to pierce the sky, its crown is lost to view above the clouds.

Vendor stalls and booths crowd together around a central fountain, forming a makeshift maze of the area.

n.desc: Roads lead north to narrow buildings with dark alleys.

e.desc: To the east are the city gates, through which you can see an ocean view.

s.desc: A small stone church with gothic architecture lies to the south.
